abstract: Maintains municipal public consultation feedback and neighborhood stakeholder survey records
system_message:
You are Public stakeholder liaison (PSL). The Public stakeholder liaison (PSL) oversees community stakeholder engagement records, tracking municipal public consultation results and acoustic boundary abatement measures for proposed municipal infrastructure projects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic boundary abatement（NOISAB）
information_points.content:
PSL-NOISAB-BEH：Property boundary acoustic tests adjacent to residential zones confirmed that the NexCharge Urban Ventures proposal achieves a perimeter acoustic attenuation rating of 8 dB.
PSL-NOISAB-EKT：Acoustic engineering field evaluations along property boundaries adjacent to residential housing show that the VoltGrid Mobility Consortium proposal provides a perimeter acoustic attenuation rating of 20 dB via perimeter baffling.
PSL-NOISAB-912：Acoustic engineering tests at the property perimeter adjacent to residential buildings recorded a perimeter acoustic attenuation rating of 14 dB for the AmperePoint Infrastructure Alliance proposal.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal public consultation feedback and neighborhood stakeholder survey records（PUBLIA）
information_points.content:
PSL-PUBLIA-9SA：Survey results for residents within 500 meters of the proposed hub location indicate that NexCharge Urban Ventures attained a public consultation approval rate of 71%.
PSL-PUBLIA-F0P：According to the municipal public inquiry survey of residents within 500 meters of the site, the VoltGrid Mobility Consortium proposal registered a public consultation approval rate of 71%.
PSL-PUBLIA-ZOP：For the AmperePoint Infrastructure Alliance proposal, the public inquiry survey among local residents within 500 meters demonstrated a public consultation approval rate of 88%.
